rubricContent.textProperty: The response accurately identifies whether the corporate event (M&A, earnings, roadmap change) has material market-moving significance under Basic Inc. v. Levinson.
The response rigorously distinguishes between information corroborated by public filings/wires vs non-public unconfirmed leaks.
The response detects explicit confidentiality markers ('don't share', 'internal only') and evaluates insider duty breaches.
The response renders an appropriate binding verdict (MNPI_CONFIRMED, POTENTIAL_MNPI, or CLEARED) and recommended action (BLOCK_COMMUNICATION, ESCALATE_TO_COMPLIANCE, or APPROVE_RELEASE).
